Green Power Purchasing
For more than a decade, Intel has been one of the top
voluntary corporate purchasers of green power in the
U.S. EPA's Green Power Partnership (GPP) program. In
addition to generating on-site and off-site green power
and purchasing green power for our utility suppliers,
we purchase RECs from multiple sources of generation.
These includes wind, solar, low-impact hydro power, and
geothermal, which are certified and verified by the non-
profit Center for Resource Solutions’ Green-e* program
to meet the requirements of the GPP program.
